createTable.remarks: Single-use tickets, each carrying one user's session from a retailer application over to the single-page application

column.name: ticket_hash
column.remarks: The SHA-256 of the ticket, hex encoded; the ticket itself is never stored, so whoever reads this table cannot redeem what it lists

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: The user whose session the ticket opens

column.name: expires_at
column.remarks: The moment the ticket expires; it may be redeemed strictly before this and swept from this point on

column.name: consumed_at
column.remarks: When the ticket was redeemed; null until then, and set exactly once, which is what makes the ticket single-use
